trace.cypher:
MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE o.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT o,
  CASE WHEN o.death_date IS NOT NULL THEN o.death_date ELSE '2026-10-15' END AS end_date,
  CASE WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '-' THEN '-' ELSE '/' END AS birth_delimiter,
  CASE WHEN o.death_date IS NOT NULL AND o.death_date CONTAINS '-' THEN '-' ELSE '/' END AS end_delimiter
WITH o, end_date, birth_delimiter, end_delimiter,
  CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, birth_delimiter, 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, birth_delimiter, 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
  CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, birth_delimiter, 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day,
  CAST(SPLIT_PART(end_date, end_delimiter, 1) AS INT64) AS end_year,
  CAST(SPLIT_PART(end_date, end_delimiter, 2) AS INT64) AS end_month,
  CAST(SPLIT_PART(end_date, end_delimiter, 3) AS INT64) AS end_day
WITH o.nationality AS nationality,
  (end_year - birth_year) -
  CASE WHEN end_month * 100 + end_day < birth_month * 100 + birth_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, AVG(age) AS col2
